# The engine's `idempotency-invoice-v1` route set (U-124, engine PR #197,
# branch clientledger/invoice-core): invoice edit, void and sent,
# `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json. Client-declared until the pin has it.
# Append-only for this capability name: `keyable-invoice` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::InvoiceV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-invoice-v1`.
POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/sent
POST /api/v1/invoices/{id}/void
PUT /api/v1/invoices/{id}
